category_edits.rationale: Apply margin-BPR with margin 0.5 across all four category models to maintain ranking pressure on moderately separated pairs. Preserve the 0.8 pairwise/0.2 pointwise mixture and valid-position averaging. Model shapes and inference remain unchanged. Require the specified data-directory environment variable.

change_summary: Use margin-0.5 BPR within the existing mixed loss for all four HSTU category models, and enforce GAGC_DATA_DIR. Preserve architecture, inference, sampling and training settings.
